# Third-party notices for EnoughFactory

EnoughFactory original source is MIT licensed. The components below retain their own licenses. This file reproduces full permission/license texts and copyright notices from the installed/pinned sources used for the initial distribution. Repeated identical texts are grouped; every listed component points to its preserved text. Upstream licenses do not imply endorsement.

## Coverage and distribution

Prepared on 2026-10-05 from the production web/marketing Rollup module graphs and device/desktop esbuild inputs that contribute output bytes, plus explicit native runtime resources. Build-only development dependencies are not a claim of shipped application content. Versions come from the lockfile, package manifests and native source/binary evidence. Re-audit this inventory when dependencies or build composition change.

- The desktop carries this file under resources/notices, original envmux/EnoughUI notices, font OFLs, a separate complete Node runtime LICENSE, and Electron's original LICENSE/LICENSES.chromium.html. Keep all of them when redistributing.
- The distributed Node runtime is 22.22.0. Its complete upstream license includes its embedded dependencies and is retained at resources/runtime/LICENSE. Source: https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.22.0/ and https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/v22.22.0/LICENSE.
- Electron 44.5.1 retains its complete Chromium and dependency notices in LICENSES.chromium.html from the selected platform's official Electron archive. This large HTML notice is a separate distribution artifact rather than rewritten here. Source: https://github.com/electron/electron/releases/tag/v44.5.1.
- Fonts are Space Grotesk and Libre Caslon Text under SIL OFL 1.1; their original OFL files also stay beside the fonts. Enough brand assets retain their own MIT license.
- Agent CLIs/SDKs installed later inside user containers and Docker base images remain separate distributions with their upstream notices. EnoughFactory ships its own adapter/bridge code rather than relabeling those runtimes.
- ArtifactFS is an optional manager image. It retains its Apache-2.0 LICENSE/NOTICE and generated Go dependency notices inside the image.

## Native source availability

Unmodified node-datachannel, libdatachannel and libjuice MPL-covered source is available at the pinned source archive URLs listed below. EnoughFactory does not modify those covered files. Recipients can obtain those sources without charge from the listed upstream repositories; corresponding covered modifications must remain available if a redistributor makes any. The native platform packages are pinned at 0.33.4 and their integrity is checked during packaging. Source revisions below derive from that package's build configuration/submodule pins; OpenSSL and compiler runtime versions are read from the actual platform binaries.

Linux glibc native addons contain OpenSSL 1.1.1w; the Mac ARM64 addon contains OpenSSL 3.6.3 and the optional Intel Mac addon 3.3.1. Their platform-specific license terms are all reproduced. Legacy OpenSSL acknowledgements: “This product includes software developed by the OpenSSL Project for use in the OpenSSL Toolkit (http://www.openssl.org/)” and “This product includes cryptographic software written by Eric Young (eay@cryptsoft.com)”. The Linux GCC runtime uses GPL with the GCC Runtime Library Exception; this exception permits independently licensed application code.

## Owned container runtime and guest image provenance

The private runtime archives and exact SHA-256 pins are recorded in runtime/container/pins.json and retained in the prepared runtime provenance.json. Mac uses the unmodified Lima host helpers and guest agents plus an owned Docker CLI/guest engine; Linux uses a private static/rootless engine. Source/dependency notices above apply to the copied components. No QEMU executable is included in the Lima Mac distribution.

- **Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (Noble Numbat) server cloud image, 20260926, aarch64**: https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/noble/release-20260926/ubuntu-24.04-server-cloudimg-arm64.img ; SHA-256 1d6bffe64b848468ac97f821d369a4846d983de1800ccf6b5ec8853e85cefc55. Source catalog: https://launchpad.net/ubuntu/noble. Release packaging must bundle the exact hash-verified Canonical image for offline first VM provisioning. /usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright inside the downloaded VM. Ubuntu is a multi-license redistributed OS image. Full package notices and complete corresponding Ubuntu source package artifacts are now required for the Mac distribution, with equivalent public source download access. Existing package manifest is exact; source kit audit is underway.

===== github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2@v1.43.8 | /tmp/enoughfactory-owned-docker-go-notices/github.com_aws_aws-sdk-go-v2@v1.43.8/.github/workflows/license-check.yml | https://proxy.golang.org/github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/@v/v1.43.8.zip =====
name: License Scan

on: [pull_request]


permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  licensescan:
    name: License Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout target
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          path: sdkbase
          ref: ${{ github.base_ref }}
      - name: Checkout this ref
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          path: new-ref
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Get Diff
        run: git --git-dir ./new-ref/.git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.sha }} > refDiffFiles.txt
      - name: Get Target Files
        run: git --git-dir ./sdkbase/.git ls-files | grep -xf refDiffFiles.txt - > targetFiles.txt
      - name: Checkout scancode
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          repository: nexB/scancode-toolkit
          path: scancode-toolkit
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      # ScanCode
      - name: Self-configure scancode
        working-directory: ./scancode-toolkit
        run: ./scancode --help
      - name: Run Scan code on target
        run: cat targetFiles.txt | while read filename; do echo ./sdkbase/$filename; done | xargs ./scancode-toolkit/scancode -l -n 30 --json-pp - | grep short_name | sort | uniq >> old-licenses.txt
      - name: Run Scan code on pr ref
        run: cat refDiffFiles.txt | while read filename; do echo ./new-ref/$filename; done | xargs ./scancode-toolkit/scancode -l -n 30 --json-pp - | grep short_name | sort | uniq >> new-licenses.txt
      # compare
      - name: License test
        run: if ! cmp old-licenses.txt new-licenses.txt; then echo "Licenses differ! Failing."; exit -1; else echo "Licenses are the same. Success."; exit 0; fi

===== github.com/moby/buildkit@v0.33.1 | /tmp/enoughfactory-owned-docker-go-notices/github.com_moby_buildkit@v0.33.1/hack/dockerfiles/authors.Dockerfile | https://proxy.golang.org/github.com/moby/buildkit/@v/v0.33.1.zip =====
# syntax=docker/dockerfile-upstream:master

ARG ALPINE_VERSION=3.23

FROM alpine:${ALPINE_VERSION} AS gen
RUN apk add --no-cache git
WORKDIR /src
RUN --mount=type=bind,target=. <<EOT
  set -e
  mkdir /out
  # see also ".mailmap" for how email addresses and names are deduplicated
  {
    echo "# This file lists all individuals having contributed content to the repository."
    echo "# For how it is generated, see hack/dockerfiles/authors.Dockerfile."
    echo
    git log --format='%aN <%aE>' | LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 sort -uf
  } > /out/AUTHORS
  cat /out/AUTHORS
EOT

FROM scratch AS update
COPY --from=gen /out /

FROM gen AS validate
RUN --mount=type=bind,target=.,rw <<EOT
  set -e
  git add -A
  cp -rf /out/* .
  if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- AUTHORS)" ]; then
    echo >&2 'ERROR: Authors result differs. Please update with "make authors"'
    git status --porcelain -- AUTHORS
    exit 1
  fi
EOT

name: License Check

on: [pull_request]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  license-check:
    name: license boilerplate check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4a3601121dd01d1626a1e23e37211e3254c1c06c # v6.4.0
        with:
          go-version-file: './go.mod'
          check-latest: true
      - name: Check license headers
        run: |
          set -e
          go tool addlicense -check -l apache -c 'The Sigstore Authors' -ignore "third_party/**" -ignore "tests/testdata/**" -v *

  dependency-license-review:
    name: License and Vulnerability Scan
    uses: sigstore/community/.github/workflows/reusable-dependency-review.yml@9b1b5aca605f92ec5b1bf3681b1e61b3dbc420cc
